sql.pandaDoc.getProjectDetails: SELECT pl.project_id, pl.proposal_nbr, s.state, (select lov.name from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.id = pd.primary_financier) as financier, c.first_name AS closer_first_name, c.last_name AS closer_last_name, c.email AS closer_email, c.first_name AS customer_first_name, c.last_name AS customer_last_name, c.email AS customer_email, c.mailing_state, c.phone, c.city, c.mailing_street1, c.mailing_street2, c.postal_code, cy.country, p.project_name, cp.company_id, pd.total_cash_down_payment, pd.system_size, pd.first_cash_payment_amount, pd.total_system_price, pd.utility_company FROM flow.project p JOIN brs.project_details pd on p.id = pd.project_id JOIN brs.proposal_log pl on pl.project_id = p.id JOIN flow.contact c ON c.id = p.contact_id JOIN flow.state s ON s.id = c.state_id JOIN flow.country cy on cy.id = c.country_id JOIN flow.company_process cp on cp.id = p.company_process_id WHERE p.id = :projectId and pl.proposal_nbr = :proposalNbr
